name: 实现 ProjectService (part 1)
description:
实现 ProjectService 服务方法: createProject, getProject, listProjects
  - createProject: (request: CreateProjectRequest, userId: str) -> ProjectResponse pre=userId不为空，项目名称在用户下唯一
  - getProject: (projectId: str, userId: str) -> ProjectResponse pre=项目属于该用户
  - listProjects: (userId: str) -> List[ProjectResponse] pre=userId有效
